name: default
description: Progress toward the nearest fuel by route (+1 per px closer when driving forward, nothing while reversing, -1 per px farther: following the route pays about as much as the fuel it leads to), +500 per fuel, -5 per unit of fuel burned (a full tank costs about one fuel: every throttle and turn counts), -3000 for running dry, -100 per wall contact (even a harmless bump; again only after 0.5 s clear of walls, so wiggling against one counts once), -1000 for a full loss of health (a 25 % hit costs -250), -3000 for a wreck, -0.25 per step stopped (-30/s), and being stuck (no closer along the route than its best) costs nothing for 3 s, then rises to -0.5 per step (-60/s) at 10 s. Game points don't count: they're the score, not the lesson.
